problems.detail: The PLAN passed to the critic is null, so none of the checks requested by this wave can run: anchor uniqueness, path collisions, vocabulary fit, door shape, tooling claims, package balance and directive coverage. Every problem below is a precondition found by checking the inputs against the live tree. Each one must be resolved in the plan when it is resubmitted.
problems.fix: Re-run the wave-3 planner and pass the plan as JSON. It needs writer_packages for spw-design-studies, spw-hosts-and-history, spw-branch and root. Each package needs file entries with path, anchor, domain, form, level, lenses and est_lines. The plan also needs vocabulary_additions, a doors list and a directive-to-surface coverage map. Then run the critic again.

problems.detail: Files written by waves 1-2 already link to 21 path#anchor pairs under spw/ and to one under making/streaming/. Waves 1-3 cannot edit those source files. The targets are: spw/hosts/{jetbrains-native-features#editor_hosts_jetbrains_native, vscode-lsp-and-cache#editor_hosts_vscode_lsp_cache, vscode-commands-and-views#editor_hosts_vscode_commands, vscode-rendering#editor_hosts_vscode_rendering, jetbrains-platform#editor_hosts_jetbrains_platform, jetbrains-instruments#editor_hosts_jetbrains_instruments, known-defects#editor_hosts_defects, index#editor_hosts_index}; spw/design-research/{pipelines-and-stacks#lang_design_pipelines, type-systems#lang_design_types, spw-position-matrix#lang_design_spw_position, memory-and-systems#lang_design_memory, macros-and-homoiconicity#lang_design_macros, script-architectures#lang_design_script_architectures, feature-lineage#lang_design_lineage}; spw/theory/{valence-and-charge#spw_theory_valence, clustering-hybrid#spw_theory_clustering}; spw/perspectives/creators-and-streamers#spw_perspectives_creators; spw/history/{plan-ecology#workbench_history_plans, curriculum-plans#workbench_history_curriculum_plans, commit-gate#workbench_history_commit_gate}; making/streaming/chat-torrent-pipeline.spw#streaming_chat_torrent (linked from formal/computing/stream-processing-models.spw:37, society/platforms/twitch-plays-pokemon.spw:42 and making/streaming/index.spw:38,46).
problems.fix: Keep each of these paths and file anchors exactly as final-plan-v2.json has them. Do not rename or split any of these files: a split-watch split of vscode-commands-and-views must keep #editor_hosts_vscode_commands on the original path. Add a frozen_targets list to the plan, and have the gate confirm that every one of these targets resolves after wave 3.

problems.detail: The live vocabulary.spw still uses the old form set: index, outline, curriculum, field_guide, glossary, timeline, case_study, comparison, protocol, catalog, ledger, registry, trail, calendar, dossier, probe_battery, story_kit, bibliography, contract. All 245 files already written use these forms (ledger 33, comparison 30, timeline 23 and so on). The forms that final-plan-v2 assigns to the four wave-3 packages are absent from that set: glossary_lattice, comparison_matrix, claim_ledger, state_machine, timeline_ladder, case_dossier, kit, cadence_schedule, prerequisite_dag and panel. spw-cut-gate.ts:287 fails any #:form outside the set. If root switches to the v2 form set, every wave 1-2 file would fail instead.
problems.fix: Map each v2 form to a live form: glossary_lattice→glossary, comparison_matrix→comparison, claim_ledger→ledger, timeline_ladder→timeline, case_dossier→dossier, kit→story_kit (or catalog), cadence_schedule→calendar, prerequisite_dag→curriculum. state_machine has no live equivalent. It is used 7 times: streaming_chat_torrent, spw_theory_epistemic_status, editor_hosts_vscode_lsp_cache, editor_hosts_jetbrains_instruments, workbench_history_commit_gate, spw_transforms and spw_perspectives_engineers. Either map those to protocol, or add state_machine and panel to vocabulary_additions so root appends them to the set without replacing it. Domains and levels are fine: spw, spw_perspectives, spw_theory, lang_design, editor_hosts, workbench_history, streaming and graduate all exist.

problems.detail: In v2, spw-branch's transforms surface uses the verbs expand, comprehend, reduce, transform and project. The live transform set is expansion, comprehension, reduction, transformation and comparison, so it has no projection. The owner's IR and attention directives will likely want lenses such as attention, token role or inspection depth. None of these is among the 16 live lenses, and the gate fails an unknown ~#lens (gate:335).
problems.fix: Either use the live transform values or add 'projection' to vocabulary_additions. Put every new lens in vocabulary_additions and use it in at least two files, since the vocabulary's rule is that a value earns its place by recurring. Tie inspection-and-ir to the live care ladder (glance, skim, read, audit, adversarial) instead of creating a new depth vocabulary.

problems.detail: The 340 anchors planned in v2 contain no duplicates, and none of the 89 wave-3 anchors exists yet apart from cut_vocabulary and cut_contract, which are expected. Canon already uses some nearby names, though: spw_index, spw_cli_conventions, spw_dialect_registry, spw_editing, spw_editor_surface_audit, spw_probe_loop, spw_probe_archive, spw_topology, spw_tooling_* (vscode, intellij, neovim, comparison, editor_instruments, polyglot_lsp_search), spw_cache_* (including spw_cache_lang_* and spw_cache_jetbrains_cache_layer), spw_ocean_* and spw_surfaces_*. The cut itself holds spw_for_streamers_* in making/streaming/spw-for-streamers.spw. Canon also has 10 duplicate anchors that predate this wave: anchor, anchor_name, id, name, runtime, wonder_roots and wonder_lib_spwv020alpha_architecture_{index,layout}_{1,2}. The persona amendments add spw/glossary/*, spw/specimens/*, spw/contraptions/* and concepts/* without proposing anchors.
problems.fix: Prefix every new anchor with its package namespace (spw_, lab_ or spw_theory_/lang_design_, hosts_/editor_hosts_/workbench_history_, cut_/trail_/panel_). Do not start new anchors with spw_cache_, spw_tooling_, spw_ocean_, spw_for_streamers or spw_surfaces_. Do not use generic names such as anchor, id, name or runtime. Keep the v2 rule that anchors in domain spw never begin with spw_theory_ or spw_perspectives_. Before handing off, run grep -rhoE '#>[A-Za-z_][\w-]*' .spw docs lib | sort | uniq -d against the planned list combined with the existing anchors.

problems.detail: Several entries in persona-synthesis.json's tree_amendments target files owned by wave 1-2 packages: matter/water.spw (amend edges), which now lives at physical/materials/water.spw and is owned by materials-and-engineering; provenance/manifest.spw, owned by provenance-and-reference; registries/quantities/<branch>.spw for health, media, stagecraft, society, linguistics and learning, whose classes are covered by registries named per package (plants-ecology-care, record-and-carriers, film-stage-visual, language-and-communities, learning-and-generations); and making/streaming/ outside chat-torrent-pipeline.spw, which belongs to creators-and-platforms.
problems.fix: Do not plan edits to these files. Record each one as a ^["promote"] row in spw/plugin-theory.spw or spw/theory-questions.spw, naming the source anchor, the target path and the evidence. New registries go only in registries/{quantities,sources}/spw-branch.spw, in lab/hosts registries, or under new names each assigned to exactly one wave-3 package. Examples are registries/quantities/dimensions.spw and registries/symmetries.spw, either for root or for spw-branch.

problems.detail: The last tree amendment edits repository tooling outside the cut: scripts/analyzers/spw-cut-gate.ts, spw-syntax-validate.ts, packages/spw-seed/src/math/corpus.ts, and spw-lsp server-index and display.ts. This wave is read-only except for cut paths and references/spw-branch/. The resume direction also holds those plans: cli-mode-overhaul is held, and the server-index worktrees are unapplied.
problems.fix: Express these as proposed probes or plan-card rows that carry #!speculative, together with the settling probe. They must never appear as file edits in any package.

problems.detail: The doors in persona-synthesis are timed, multi-step paths. The first is for 'everyone (shared first hour)': step 1 is a 5-minute door router, then step 2 is a 10-minute false-friend glossary, and so on. The amendments also propose doors/first-hour.spw and trails such as hour-one-bundle and floating-week, and root's v2 adds trail_spw_first_contact. The owner hold says newcomers land on one fragment and that 'a command tour as onboarding' is refused (resume/2026-09-30-direction.spw arrival and refuse; contract.spw:196).
problems.fix: Make each door one fragment: a single sigil or region that is legible alone, with the rest left quiet. Doors carry no minutes, no step order and no command list. Drop doors/first-hour.spw and any hour-one bundle. If 12 cluster doors are kept, each opens on one specimen fragment. spw-first-contact and rendering-and-cli must open on a fragment, not a list of verbs. A practiced circuit can be linked from inside a door, but it is never the door.

problems.detail: The owner hold says to keep charge, meaning what kind of difference something is, off the visit arc, meaning how far along a reader is, and not to map valence onto phases. The wave-3 surfaces most likely to drift here are spw/theory/valence-and-charge.spw, the perspectives' ladders, and trails that use the season arc (reflection, gathering, crescendo, celebration, reset).
problems.fix: Add a check line to valence-and-charge, the perspectives index and the spw trail. Valence and #:season or arc rungs must never be laid on the same axis or ladder.

problems.detail: Of the 19 contraptions, only one (Kerning specimen) has tooling_status exists. Thirteen need a small CLI addition and five need a new tool: Dimension bench (no exact nullSpace in equation.ts), Commutation/law lab, Operator × bound table, Operator authority map and Registry derivation checker. Specific features named in the study do not exist: 'spw select --selector wildcard/hole', a closure verb, a band-ladder checker and elementary-cycle enumeration (detectCycle returns one witness). The seeds in references/spw-branch/seeds/contraptions run through a scratch check.mts with a '<repo>' import placeholder, so they are not shipped tooling. The persona doors also cite 'index.spw ^["doors"] (proposed)'.
problems.fix: Every contraption row carries a tooling_status. Rows that are not 'exists' are marked proposed (#!speculative) and name the plan card or verb that would build them. Every 'exists' claim cites file:line, for example graph.ts:76 and :125, field.ts:56 and :250, and measure-protocol.ts:441. Scratch scripts are labelled as scratch. inspection-and-ir and tokens-and-roles cite packages/spw-seed/src/ir/{granularity,lens,ref,cache-layer}.ts and canonical/normalize.ts by path:line and describe current behavior, not intended behavior.

problems.detail: The v2 baselines are uneven. spw-design-studies has 16 files and about 2505 lines, against spw-hosts-and-history at 20 and 3155, spw-branch at 25 and 3205, and root at 28 and 3280. Adding the persona amendments to spw-branch would push it past 80 files: 12 doors, 4 glossary files, 12 specimens, 19 contraption files, 7 concept hubs, tool-matrix, questions, and registries for probes, symmetries and dimensions. The hosts package also outweighs the language-design package, while the owner hold says host caches are residue and that language, mathematics, physics, linguistics and attention lead.
problems.fix: Keep each package within about 20–28 files and 2500–3300 estimated lines. Collapse the 19 contraptions into spw/contraptions.spw (story_kit) plus at most 5 to 6 separate files. Give spw-design-studies the specimens or the false-friend glossary, since it has about 700 lines of headroom. Fold the concept hubs into root's panels/concept-lattice.spw instead of adding a concepts/ directory. Cap hosts at its v2 size and add no new host files.

problems.detail: The persona amendments add doors/ and concepts/ at the root of the cut and spw/glossary/, spw/specimens/ and spw/contraptions/ under spw/. None of these is in v2's top_level list or package owns_dirs. concepts/ overlaps root's panels/concept-lattice.spw, and spw/glossary/ overlaps the planned spw/spw-glossary.spw (spw_glossary).
problems.fix: Assign each new directory to exactly one wave-3 package, or fold it into an existing planned file. Root would own any new top-level directory and must list it in index.spw. If spw/glossary/ is kept, make spw-glossary.spw its index or drop one of the two, so that two surfaces do not cover the same lattice.

problems.detail: v2 says spw-branch starts only after spw-design-studies and spw-hosts-and-history land and every branch package publishes its claim-anchor list. Waves 1-2 are still writing, so no claim-anchor lists exist yet. Trails in root are drafted from frozen file anchors and finalized later.
problems.fix: State the order explicitly: design-studies and hosts-and-history first, then spw-branch, then root last. Until the lists exist, spw-branch cites only file-level anchors that v2 freezes. Leave a probe in each surface naming the claim anchor it will bind to later.

problems.detail: With no plan, coverage of the owner's directives cannot be checked. Five directives are covered at least partly in v2: AST/tokenizer for machine empathy and tunable complexity (tokens-and-roles, inspection-and-ir); IR as a design surface for unpredictable care (inspection-and-ir); rendering and CLI for metacognition (rendering-and-cli, predict/check/compare/reflect); the CLI as how others talk about Spw (rendering-and-cli, hosts/cli-readings, history/cli-arcs); and mathematical contraptions (spw/contraptions). Two directives have no clear home: ANSI keyboards and C-style habits beyond the c-family perspective, which covers no keyboard or keystroke-cost material; and wonder in exploring the design of languages and materials, which has no surface linking lang_design to physical/materials. Conceptual clustering for physics students and graphic designers maps to perspectives/physicists, perspectives/designers and spw_theory_clustering, but nothing says the doors are organized by concept cluster.
problems.fix: Add a coverage map with at least one owned surface per directive. One option is a section in familiarity-and-false-friends, or a c-family specimen, that gives ANSI shifted-key cost per sigil, marked interpretive and without assuming any tool. Another is a wonder or materials bridge, such as a lang_design file linking to physical/materials/water.spw#materials_water. That bridge must be outbound-only so it never edits wave 1-2 files. Doors for physicists and designers should be arranged by concept cluster: conservation, symmetry, scaling, layout and grid.
